items.markdown:
You can `listen to free, continuous, ad-free brown noise online` using the [Brown Noise Generator](https://brownnoise.com/).[[1]](https://brownnoise.com/)

Brown noise (also known as red noise) features a deep, low-frequency rumble similar to a heavy waterfall or a distant airplane cabin. It contains more energy at lower frequencies and less at higher frequencies than white or pink noise, making it softer and smoother to human ears.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P48QELwruQs)[[2]](https://slonoise.com/play/brown-noise/)[[3]](https://29a.ch/noise-generator/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pfJfe1H9Jk4)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RqzGzwTY-6w)

### Free Online Generators

- **BrownNoise.com:** A completely free, minimalist web player featuring one-tap play/pause and a customizable sleep timer.
- **[Slo Noise](https://slonoise.com/play/brown-noise/):** A free browser-based player that lets you mix brown noise with background sounds like rain.
- **[Muted.io Noise Generator](https://muted.io/noise-generator/):** An interactive tool allowing you to toggle between white, pink, and brown noise with custom filter adjustments.
- **[SimplyNoise](https://simplynoise.com/):** One of the original web-based color noise generators providing classic brown noise streams.[[1]](https://muted.io/noise-generator/)[[2]](https://brownnoise.com/)[[3]](https://slonoise.com/play/brown-noise/)[[4]](https://simplynoise.com/)

### Benefits of Brown Noise

- **Sleep and Relaxation:** The deep, steady rumble helps mask sudden nighttime disturbances like traffic, loud HVAC units, or barking dogs.
- **Focus and ADHD:** The deep broadband sound helps calm a racing mind, mask distracting office sounds, and improve concentration for studying or working.
- **Tinnitus Relief:** The lack of harsh high-pitched static provides a soothing backdrop that can help lessen the perception of ringing in the ears.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RqzGzwTY-6w)[[2]](https://slonoise.com/play/brown-noise/)[[3]](https://29a.ch/noise-generator/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pfJfe1H9Jk4)

If you'd like, I can help you find **dedicated mobile apps** or recommend **hardware sound machines** for bedside use.
